final_message:
Wrote a privileged FLSA and state-law classification memo for the CEAS role (18 positions in Austin, Irvine and Portland). It concludes the role is non-exempt everywhere: in California it fails the $68,640 salary floor and the more-than-50% exempt-duties test; federally (and so in Texas and Oregon) it likely fails the administrative duties test, since 75% of the work is non-exempt. It also explains why the Thornbury letter cannot be relied on, estimates willfulness and overtime exposure, and lists remediation steps. The file passed validate.py and opened cleanly when parsed back.
